purpose: Governed advanced-runtime pilots that can materially expand motion quality while keeping Remotion as the single export authority.
rule: Pilot before dependency. A candidate becomes production runtime only after one real use case, deterministic render QA, license review, performance check and measurable creative benefit.

pilots.name: Rive inside Remotion
pilots.authoringRuntime: Rive .riv + state machines/data binding where useful
pilots.why: Official Remotion bridge removes the need for a separate export pipeline. Rive is strong for reusable reactive vector components and designer/developer state contracts.
acceptance: verify frame determinism and brand token behavior
keep only if reuse/editability or visual quality is materially better

pilots.name: React Three Fiber / Three.js inside Remotion
pilots.why: Official Remotion integration keeps 3D frame-accurate and exposes current-frame-driven R3F scenes; WebGPU canvas/TSL materials can support richer premium surfaces without a second video renderer.
acceptance: build one abstract first-party water/material scene
verify it adds depth/material richness beyond 2D solution
keep deterministic factual overlays outside 3D scene

externalAuthoring.use: Create approved conceptual 3D assets/reference frames, then import/export into governed production.
externalAuthoring.warning: Spline AI output is conceptual, not documentary truth. Paid/external authoring does not grant factual status.
